# WWF No Mercy (`mat-kings`) — Wiring Inventory

**Game:** WWF No Mercy (AKI, N64) · **WH universe:** `mat-kings` (RENAME-MAP.md)
**Tree:** mhvnsnt/western-heart main @ fa4f3757341160f03aebb3d18e0f52d7b29e9020
**Count method:** GitHub git-tree API (recursive, `truncated: false`) cross-checked with
`git ls-tree -rz --name-only HEAD -- teardown/wwf-no-mercy` — **18,544 files**, 53,506,474 bytes.
**Audit date:** 2026-10-20 (FULL WIRING + CANON CONVERSION lane, owner order 2026-10-20 ~08:06 CDT)
**Per-game conversion record:** `teardown/wwf-no-mercy/CANON-CONVERSION.md`

"Wired" = the game/build actually consumes it (roster data, moveset-library/, stage registry,
game/assets, creation/customization data, canon the game reads). A file merely existing is NOT wired.

No retargeted output exists under `game/assets/anim/`. Library-scale retarget is a flagged gap, not done work. |

## The 10 wrestler models (13 GLBs) — ACCOUNTED-ELSEWHERE

Not in this tree (only the 2 environment menu-scene GLBs above are). Per owner law they live in
the wrestling repos — mhvnsnt/wrestlemania-xix-mod under `mods/no-mercy-wrestlers/`, also
mhvnsnt/Bannon and mhvnsnt/wrestling-game. `textures/inventory.json` records their extraction
provenance (e.g. `characters/kevin_nash/kevin_nash_1.glb`, `characters/kurt_angle/kurt_angle_1.glb`).
They are not missing and are NOT copied into Western Heart.
